question: Our API uses client credentials flow where apps exchange their ID and secret for a temporary access key. Our response fields are named 'token' and 'ttl' instead of the standard names. How do I map these? Where do developers put their client ID and secret? Will the library automatically get a new token before the old one expires?
ground_truth: To configure OAuth 2.0 client credentials flow in Fern, you need two configuration files. In api.yml, set up an OAuthScheme under `auth-schemes` with `scheme: oauth` and `type: client-credentials`. Specify environment variable names for credentials using `client-id-env` and `client-secret-env` (this is where SDK users will provide their credentials). Configure the `get-token` section with the endpoint reference and crucially, use `request-properties` and `response-properties` to map OAuth standard parameter names to your actual API's field names - for example, mapping standard `access-token` to your `$response.token` and `expires-in` to your `$response.ttl`. In a separate auth.yml file, define the token retrieval endpoint with your actual request body properties and response structure. The generated SDKs will automatically handle token retrieval at initialization and refresh tokens before expiration using the expires_in/ttl value, without developers needing to implement this logic manually. Important: OAuth client credentials authentication is only available for Pro & Enterprise customers.

metadata.cited_context:
If your API uses OAuth, you can specify an oauth scheme in `api.yml` and define a token retrieval endpoint in a separate `auth.yml` file. 

```yaml api.yml
auth: OAuthScheme
auth-schemes:
  OAuthScheme:
    scheme: oauth
    type: client-credentials
    client-id-env: YOUR_CLIENT_ID
    client-secret-env: YOUR_CLIENT_SECRET
    get-token:
      endpoint: auth.getTokenWithClientCredentials
      request-properties:
        client-id: $request.client_id
        client-secret: $request.client_secret
      response-properties:
        access-token: $response.access_token
        expires-in: $response.expires_in
```

The `request-properties` and `response-properties` map OAuth standard parameters to your actual endpoint's request and response field names defined in `auth.yml`.
